name: replyspark-monorepo
description: ReplySpark - AI-Powered Google Review Management SaaS
author: ashokadvait

scripts.build: pnpm --filter @replyspark/shared build && pnpm --filter @replyspark/db generate && pnpm -r --filter=!replyspark-monorepo build
scripts.services:up: docker start replyspark-postgres replyspark-redis 2>/dev/null || (docker run -d --name replyspark-postgres -e POSTGRES_USER=replyspark -e POSTGRES_PASSWORD=replyspark_secret -e POSTGRES_DB=replyspark -p 5432:5432 postgres:16-alpine && docker run -d --name replyspark-redis -p 6379:6379 redis:7-alpine)
